snippet.title: WCW Superbrawl Wrestling Playthrough (SNES) (HARD MODE) (Perfect)
snippet.description:
MONDAY NIGHT WARS REVISTED PT. 2 -  The Monday Night Wars was arguably my favorite era of wrestling with WWF and WCW battling it out in to be the best Pro-wrestling show of the era. Was never the same again after WCW was bought out by WWF. It truly was the golden age. So this is a 2-part series of playthroughs with one playthrough a WWF game and the other a WCW game. 

While WWF has 4 games on the SNES and Genesis there was only 1 WCW game for the 16 bit consoles and only on SNES. While many people have criticized this game for slow game play, I am perhaps more fond of this game then any other wrestling game out there. I find it very unfortunate at how forgotten and obscure this game has become. It was my very first wrestling game that I ever owned and along with WWF Super Wrestlemania, I have spent many hours over the years playing this game and loving every minute of it. It was also my introduction to WCW and unknowingly the Monday Night Wars which was raging on cable at the time. Love how all the wrestlers have unique finishing moves that are easy to pull off and are definitely effective at turning the tides in the match if used at the right time....Vader's Power Bomb is just devastating to say the least. While the game has certainly aged (and not wonderfully in areas), it still remains a very playable and decent wrestling game if you give it the time. If your tired of the over-the-top arcade action of the later WWF games and crave a little more realism, then give this WCW game that time has forgotten a try! Thanks for watching!

Hope you enjoy!


Check out some of my favorite channels here as well like The Game Chasers, AVGN/Cinemassacre, Mike Matei Plays, Retroblasting, Cornshaq Gaming, Ed's Retro Geek Out!, Gaming Historian, Minty Comedic Arts, Almost Human, WhatCulture Wrestling etc.
